title: 人工知能技術戦略実行計画

policy_extraction.issuing_body: 人工知能技術戦略会議（内閣府・総務省・文部科学省・経済産業省等）

evidence.quote: 各取組の目標と達成時期を示した実行計画を暫定的に取りまとめた
政府が取り組む主要な実証実験について、目標、取組状況、制度的・法的課題等を一体的に把握・整理して、関係府省で共有

compliance_deadlines: 2018年度中：各府省IT人材育成規模設定
2018年度中：応用開発内容の明確化
2018年中：農業データ利活用契約ガイドライン策定
2019年度中：インフラ・データプラットフォーム構築試行
2020年中：多言語音声翻訳社会実装
2020年度中：医師付き画像データ企業提供体制整備
2022年度まで：各分野AIの社会実装

2032年まで：初等中等教育修了全生徒のITリテラシー獲得
policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This is a government implementation plan (実行計画) translating the 2017 AI Technology Strategy and industrialization roadmap into concrete targets with deadlines and responsible ministries. It is not legally binding. No prohibited practices or enforcement penalties are specified. The document covers R&D, human resource development, data/tool environment, venture support, and public understanding across priority domains: productivity, health/medical/care, mobility, and information security.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document frames AI governance primarily as a competitiveness challenge, explicitly noting Japan's lag behind the US and China in research, talent, data, and venture support, and calling for Japan to 'win fierce competition' and 'lead the world.' The industrialization roadmap, sectoral productivity targets, and market acquisition goals further reinforce this frame. Innovation enablement is secondary, as the plan details R&D and social implementation programs. Labor/talent transition appears through extensive workforce development sections.
